title: The Biscuit Crate
introNarration: Nett turns the empty cord at his neck. "South, then east, the cargo hollow. Examine the biscuit crate. A deck-hand keeps the skiff-line on the way. Defeat him if he squares up. Then talk nett. I carried the tin. I will not carry it back."
reminderNarration: "Examine the biscuit crate in the cargo hollow. Defeat the deck-hand on the skiff-line. Then talk nett. Type south from Willow Bend."
completionNarration: Nett nods at the empty crate and gives you the dented tin. "Midge is west and south, on the heron post. Talk midge. She hung a whistle. The camp kept it. I am going to sit until Marram says I may tie a knot again."

objectives.label: Examine the Biscuit Crate in the Cargo Hollow. Type south from the skiff-line.
Defeat the Deck Hand on the Skiff Line. Type south from Willow Bend.
